meta.title: Neural Persistent Memory
meta.description: Titans-style neural persistent memory: filters long-term weight updates via prediction-error surprise and momentum, with natural weight decay, recall rehearsal, and optional auto-observe / auto-recall lifecycle integration. Provides 6 tools: nm_observe, nm_recall, nm_forget, nm_status, nm_export, nm_delete.

tool.nm_observe: Feed text and update associative memory weights only when prediction surprise passes dual thresholds
tool.nm_recall: Read out via associative matrix M and verify candidates through dual score + lexical coverage gates
tool.nm_forget: Apply one round of weight decay to simulate a natural forgetting curve
tool.nm_status: Inspect entry count, dimension/mode, weight bytes, average surprise, and lifecycle status
tool.nm_export: Export the associative memory matrix and entries to an atomic JSON snapshot
tool.nm_delete: Explicitly erase entries with persistent tombstones and projection unlearning
